outcome: Maintenance of intraoperative systolic blood pressure (SBP)
Maternal complications (Headache, Shivering, Local tissue ischemia)
cohort: The study included 60 pregnant females undergoing lower segment caesarean section under subarachnoid block, divided into two groups of 30.
finding: Intravenous norepinephrine was found to control blood pressure in parturients after subarachnoid block but required a significantly higher number of boluses compared to mephentermine, with comparable maternal complications and neonatal APGAR scores.
followup_time: Up to 5 minutes post-birth for neonates and till completion of surgery for mothers
